distribution_spearman.note: Within-city node-level Spearman rho. Reference values from displacement analysis: at rho>=0.80, MAPD=7.6 (74% skill), Q-flip=35.1%.

benchmark_rank.note: Between-city weighted POA on city-level median(log1p(count)). Use as guidance for broad comparative ordering rather than exact city rank.

benchmark_hotspot.note: Between-city weighted POA on city-level top-10%-median(log1p(count)). Same broad-ordering rationale as benchmark_rank.
